description: This file defines a PHP class SaveReportingMethodController within the OrangeHRM framework, specifically in the PIM module. The class extends an abstract controller and manages component rendering based on request attributes, particularly handling reporting method save and edit actions.

classes.name: SaveReportingMethodController
classes.description: Controller class for handling saving and editing reporting methods within the HRM system, dynamically setting Vue components based on request data.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component to be rendered based on the request attributes. Uses request data to decide whether to load an edit or save component for reporting methods.
